purpose: Expand real-world regulatory coverage beyond the two existing MHRA Gold Cases without changing production source hierarchies.
governance_note: FDA records are corpus-only. They do not change the current REGULATORY_STATUS source_type hierarchy and are not promoted to Gold Cases in this phase.

records.legal_locator: The Medicines (Aristolochia and Mu Tong etc.) (Prohibition) Order 2001 SI 1841; Aristolochia table rows
MHRA table: All Aconitum species; POM and SI 2130 Parts II & III
records.regulatory_effect: No permitted internal dose unless supplied by prescription from a registered doctor or dentist; external preparations permitted at 1.3% or below.

records.legal_locator: MHRA table: Adonis vernalis; SI 2130 Parts II and III
records.regulatory_effect: Internal use is limited to 100 mg maximum single dose and 300 mg maximum daily dose; no external dose is permitted.

records.legal_locator: MHRA table: Areca catechu; SI 2130 Part I
records.regulatory_effect: May only be sold from registered pharmacy premises by or under pharmacist supervision.

records.legal_locator: MHRA table: Gelsemium sempervirens; SI 2130 Parts II and III
records.regulatory_effect: Internal use is limited to 25 mg maximum single dose and 75 mg maximum daily dose; external supply is pharmacy-supervised.

records.legal_locator: MHRA table: Lobelia inflata; SI 2130 Parts II and III
records.regulatory_effect: Internal use is limited to 200 mg maximum single dose and 600 mg maximum daily dose; external supply is pharmacy-supervised.

records.legal_locator: MHRA table: Pausinystalia yohimbe; SI 2130 Part I
records.regulatory_effect: Yohimbe bark may only be sold from registered pharmacy premises by or under pharmacist supervision.

records.legal_locator: Medicines for Human Use (Prohibition) (Senecio and Miscellaneous Amendments) Order 2008
records.regulatory_effect: Sale, supply or importation of medicines containing Senecio species or extracts is prohibited.

records.botanical_name: Ephedra spp. and other botanical sources of ephedrine alkaloids
records.legal_locator: FDA ingredient page; Final Rule, 69 Fed. Reg. 6787 (Feb. 11, 2004), 21 CFR 119.1
records.regulatory_effect: FDA banned sale of dietary supplements containing ephedrine alkaloids because they present an unreasonable risk.

records.botanical_name: Symphytum officinale and related comfrey species
records.legal_locator: FDA ingredient page: Comfrey; Safety communication (July 2001)
records.regulatory_effect: FDA's selected-ingredient resource links the July 2001 safety communication advising dietary supplement manufacturers to remove comfrey products from the market.

records.botanical_name: Aristolochia spp. / Aristolochiaceae products containing aristolochic acid
records.product_scope: bulk or finished dietary supplement products containing aristolochic acid
records.regulatory_effect: FDA instructs detention without physical examination for specified bulk or finished dietary supplement products containing aristolochic acid.
